Title
* Consider using consistent letter cases (either lowercase "speed" or title case "Distance").

* Please add a comma after "Time".

Goal
* Please rewrite the first sentence as follows:

Given two of the three values, [[time]], [[speed]] and [[distance]], calculate the missing one.

Input
* Please add "separated by a space" after "[[distance]]".

* Please change "?" to "{{?}}" and remove the quotation marks.

* Please remove "however".

Output
* Please replace the current wording with:

The missing value

Constraints
* Please indicate the upper bounds of all three variables.

* Please add:
Any division performed will result in an integer; no rounding is required.

Thanks.

Title
* Please
  • either change "Speed" to "speed"
  • or change "distance" to "Distance".

Input
* Please add "separated by a space" after "[[distance]]".

* Please add "and the other two values are integers" after "{{?}}".

Thanks.
